name: Pie chart
purpose: Composition / proportion as a full ring, no centre figure — ported from Chart-donut.reference.html (wave-2 lane ③, 2026-08-05) with the inner radius dropped to 0 and the DV-D13 centre-total wiring removed (donut-only, per brief). Segment popover · table-view popover · legend-as-filter/isolate/highlight · value ⇄ % segmented toggle (baked variant groups) · optional title + H-stack head · high-contrast remap — all copied from the donut's Layer-2 verbatim.
when: answers=composition AND parts ≤ 5 AND total=not printed — yields to chart-donut (80, "composition, a centre total is meaningful") whenever a centre total is wanted, which is the only thing separating the two; yields to chart-stacked-area (64) when the split moves over time.

not-with.when: the same composition is already drawn as a ring with a centre total — pick one, pie or donut, not both

props.name: labelling
props.$note: spider = letter on a short leader outside the ring + vertical legend [swatch][letter][name]; direct = name + value in place, no legend. D-Q2 (spider vs direct default) stays OPEN — cited, not re-decided; both variants shown, same posture as the donut.

props.name: slices
props.$note: Maximum 6 (dv-pie-009); more → combine smallest into 'Other'. Values must sum to the total carried on data-total (dv-pie-010) even though no centre figure displays it.

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state = the Empty-state pattern by reference.

props.name: valueMode
props.$note: Segmented-control atom (.seg.sm) drives BAKED variant groups (data-dv-view) — direct labels AND the table column mirror the active mode. JS-off = value view.

props.name: title
props.$note: Optional visible title (.dv-title, t-cm-section-label) in the H-stack head; sr-only figcaption still names the chart when absent.

variants.name: spider + legend
variants.use: Default composition view; letters bridge chart ↔ legend (§04.3).

variants.name: direct labels
variants.use: Self-contained view (print/export-friendly); name + £value · % on each leader.

variants.name: no data
variants.use: Empty-state pattern in the chart frame.

tokens.series: data/series/1–5 (same series as the donut; identical measured contrast)
tokens.separation: stroke = background/default (page) at 2px on every segment (dv-004)
tokens.labels: text/default (ink) — spider letters and direct labels never sit ON the fills
tokens.$survey: No new tokens minted. ds-020 check: pie/donut carry NO axis or gridline CSS at all, so there is nothing to inherit or receipt under that fence for this pair.

motion.entry: RADIAL SWEEP RETURNS (ADR-0015: data-driven geometry is JS territory) — segments bake the sweep contract (data-cx/-cy/-ro/-a1/-a2, NO data-ri) + data-seq on annotations; the sweep hook itself is a dv-behaviour source edit = CONDUCTOR'S SERIAL. Baked state = full wedges + visible annotations, so JS-off / reduced-motion / pre-hook all render complete.

responsive.rule: Same DV-D02 exclusion as the donut — fixed geometry (compressing a circle distorts); .dv-stage scrolls if the container is narrower.

mustNotNeighbour: A second composition chart of the same data (pick one — pie or donut, not both)
Charts re-using these series colours for different data (dv-014)

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="group", aria-label carries subject + total.
accessibility.name: Figcaption names the chart; every segment carries aria-label == data-tip == table (name, value, percentage — one source); the real table is the full data surface.
accessibility.keyboard: Segments = focus stops (tabindex 0 → dvTip on focus); legend rows = buttons (Enter toggles, Shift+Enter isolates); seg view switch + CSV + table dropdown all native buttons; table panel takes focus on open, Esc returns it.
accessibility.focus: 2px ink outline on segments/buttons/panel (focus-visible); seg buttons inset −2.
accessibility.nonText: Segment fills ≥3:1 vs the page both modes; identity = letter/name + position + table, never colour alone (1.4.1); 2px page strokes keep adjacent segments separable.

antiPatterns: Segment values that don't sum to the declared total (dv-pie-010)
Gapless segments without the 2px page stroke (dv-004)
White letters on segment fills (type26-013 — white type is red-only; label in ink outside the ring)
A pie without its real data table (dv-005)
Proportionally scaling the ring down (DV-D02 exclusion — it distorts)
Signalling a control's off state by dimming alone (the legend off-state is the hollow-swatch + data/axis grey recipe)
Recomputing arc geometry at runtime outside the sweep hook (geometry is generation-time; behaviour only toggles baked variants)
Porting the donut's centre-total / DV-D13 selection-follow wiring across (donut-only, explicitly fenced by the brief)

behaviour.fallback: With CSS on and JS off the spider/legend canvas renders as an EMPTY <svg> and no pie is drawn — dvRender is what fills it. The data is not lost and is not unlabelled: the figure carries a real <table class="dv-table"> inside a native <details>/<summary> disclosure (s116-D2), authored in the markup and not generated, so the five categories, their pounds and their percentage shares open and read with no script at all (dv-005 tabular alternative + the a11y spine). The engine REWRITES those same rows from the spec when it runs, so the popover value and the table value are one number by construction. The DIRECT-LABEL canvas stays baked, so a complete pie, its leaders and its in-place labels all render with JS off. Lost with JS off: the value popover, the DV-D11 legend filter/isolate, the value ⇄ percent toggle and Copy CSV.
behaviour.$note: Typed #260 (s259-D1 fast follower, pie lane). `script` addresses the ENGINE CORE — dv-render.js is where this component's behaviour begins; the wedges are drawn through its type registry by dv-render-donut.js, which is named in `partial`. THERE IS NO dv-render-pie: dv-render-donut registers BOTH `donut` and `pie` off one ring(ctx, hole) routine (a pie is that ring with ri = 0), so Chart-pie COMPOSES the donut partial rather than duplicating the trigonometry — the same reading _validate_dataviz.py's ENGINE_TEST_PAGE already commits to ("pie is the ri=0 arm of the same partial", mapping this snippet's driven receipt to _tests/chart-engine/donut.html). `partial` lists ALL FOUR registered AUTO-BEHAVIOUR names the snippet carries, per the schema's own wording and the chart-donut precedent.
